@note: Material flow add-on for ModelCraft (0.8 SU.858, session sx-flow). {var} placeholders are filled in by the add-on.
panel.title: Material flow
panel.note: Loads move without physics (they never tip or tumble). Connecting to a PLC is planned for CadCraft Studio later.
confirm.new: Start a new layout? The one in this browser is replaced (save it first if you want to keep it).
add.title: Add from the catalog
items.title: Items ({n})
plc.title: PLC (Modbus TCP)
plc.intro: {gates} stop gate(s) take their open and close commands from a PLC. A PLC reads the photo-eyes and the counters and writes the gates' coils; the model runs at the pace of the clock. The plant is kinematic: a PLC cannot make a belt faster.
plc.nogate: Set a stop gate's mode to "Set by a PLC" to give a PLC control of it. The photo-eyes are readable already.
plc.start.hint: Studio listens on this computer for a PLC (Modbus TCP) while the live run goes
plc.studio: A PLC connects through CadCraft Studio, which opens the socket on this computer. Here you can save the address list for the PLC programmer.
plc.listening: Waiting for a PLC on this computer, port {port}.
plc.nolink: This window has no PLC link (use CadCraft Studio on the desktop).
plc.refused: Studio could not open the port: {why}
fleet.title: AGV fleet
run.title: Simulate
play.title: Playback
play.note: Playback covers the first {hours} h of the run; the statistics cover the whole run after the warm-up.
play.full: The trace filled up early: playback stops before that.
stats.title: Results
stat.wip: In the system at the end
msg.snapped: {id} snapped onto the nearest free port.
msg.noSnap: No free port within 0.6 m to snap to.
msg.example: Example loaded. Press Run, then Play.
msg.openedDropped: Opened; {n} items could not be read and were left out.
msg.notLayout: That file is not a material flow layout.
msg.tooBig: That file is too big for a layout.
msg.maxEvents: It stopped early at the event limit: run fewer hours.
problem.bad-link: {id}: a joint that does not fit.
problem.sensor-no-conveyor: {id}: a photo-eye must be on a conveyor.
problem.agv-no-drop: {id}: choose a drop to deliver to.
problem.agv-not-on-path: {id}: its marker is not on an AGV path end.
problem.agv-no-path: There are AGV pickups but no AGV path.
problem.agv-no-vehicles: The AGV fleet has no vehicles.
problem.load-too-long: {id}: a load is longer than this conveyor.
problem.agv-deadlock: vehicles {vehicles} wait for each other (segment {edge}). Add a segment or use fewer vehicles.
problem.agv-no-route: a vehicle has no way along the one-way paths.
problem.calendar-unknown: {id} uses a shift calendar that does not exist ({key}).
problem.calendar-never: The shift calendar {key} on {id} is never on: add a window.
problem.agv-blocked: Vehicle {vehicles} is stuck at the end of lane {edge} with nowhere to move aside: add a way out or a passing place.
msg.noWorker: (Ran on the page itself: this browser could not start a worker.)
msg.live: Live: the model runs at the pace you choose. Pause or stop it below.
msg.liveDone: Live run finished after {hours} h of model time.
msg.drag: Dragging {id}. Hold Shift to move everything joined to it.
msg.dragGroup: Dragging {id} and everything joined to it ({n} items).
msg.placeOn: Click in the 3D view to place a {kind}. It joins a free port within 0.6 m. Esc to stop.
mouse.on: Move and place with the mouse
mouse.note: Drag an item in the 3D view to move it (Shift moves everything joined to it); it snaps onto a free port within 0.6 m when you let go.
fleet.nodesHint: Where three or more lanes meet, only one vehicle at a time may be on the approach to the junction or standing at it.
live.hint: Run the model at the pace of the clock (speed below), with loads and vehicles moving as it goes
shifts.title: Shift calendars
shifts.note: A week that repeats; time 0 of a run is Monday 00:00. A station or source with a calendar starts no new work while it is off (work in progress finishes).
shifts.name: Name
shifts.p.three-shifts: Three shifts, Mon–Fri around the clock
shifts.to: To (HH:MM; earlier than From runs past midnight)
fleet.parkHint: Idle vehicles with no work drive to a free parking place: type the names of AGV paths, and each vehicle parks at the end of one. A vehicle that breaks down while driving stops where its current path ends.
pools.title: Operator pools
pools.note: A group of people shared by stations. A station that names a pool needs one person from it for every load it serves; when nobody is free the load waits.
pools.name: Pool name
problem.pool-unknown: {id}: the operator pool {key} does not exist.
